question: What claim is made with assurance that death is destroyed in the manner to be told?
premises: The speaker states an intention to tell something.
No doubt is said to remain.
It is stated that death is destroyed.
inference: The speaker tells without doubt that death is destroyed.
uncertainties: The manner in which death is destroyed is not given in this verse.
plain_english: I tell it; there is no doubt that death is destroyed as stated.
